verdict.rationale: Warp ships an in-product AI agent, Warp Agent, that works on the company's HR and payroll data (onboarding, payroll, tax notices, benefits) and asks the user when a decision is theirs. That implies some in-product AI-driven prompting based on the user's data, but nothing documents insights, analytics, or recommendations as a feature. The MCP access for external agents like Claude and ChatGPT runs outside the product, so it earns no credit here. Missing for 10: documented AI-generated insights or analytics on HR/payroll data, explicit in-product suggestion or recommendation features, detail on what the agent surfaces to users, independent or hands-on corroboration.
